attchmntText: UFLEX Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Uflex Limited published its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results during a meeting held on 12th November 2026. The announcement was published in the Financial Express and Jansatta on 13th November 2026. The results are available on the company website and the NSE and BSE portals. The document includes consolidated and standalone financial data. Key metrics reported include total income, profit before tax, and net profit. Earnings per share figures are also provided. The Audit Committee reviewed the results prior to Board approval. This filing complies with Regulation 33 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: UFLEX Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Uflex Limited approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting occurred on November 12, 2026, from 5:55 PM to 7:31 PM. The results include Standalone and Consolidated figures along with a Limited Review Report from Statutory Auditors Vijay Sehgal & Co and Lodha & Co LLP. The Audit Committee reviewed the results. The auditors confirmed that the statements are prepared in accordance with Ind AS 34 and do not contain material misstatements. The consolidated results include data from subsidiaries such as Flex Films USA Inc and Uflex Packaging Inc USA. Financial figures for specific subsidiaries are reported in Lacs. The announcement is filed under Regulation 33 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: UFLEX Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: UFlex Limited has intimated that its Q2 and H1 FY27 Earnings Conference Call will be held on Monday, November 16, 2026, at 4:00 PM IST. The call is scheduled pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The company will be represented by Mr. Arun Kumar Sharma, President F&A and Group CFO, and Mr. Surajit Pal, Vice President Head of Investor Relations. Participants can join via the provided dial-in numbers or the DiamondPass link. Additional details are available on the company website.
